card.name: Digits inside large numbers
card.fires_on: Digits, or number words like six and few, partway through a large number where a thousand, hundred or million magnitude is expected next. Often in years-ago counts, sizes and money amounts with commas.

modes.label: Digits in comma-grouped numbers
modes.description: A digit within a number with thousands separators, before the remaining zeros or groups.
modes.example: The cost of the building itself totaled $945,<<3>>11.

modes.label: Approximate quantity words
modes.description: A number word or quantifier such as few or six that is followed by hundred, thousand or times.
modes.example: as recent as a<< few>> hundred thousand years ago

modes.label: Digits in ranges and sizes
modes.description: A digit inside a numeric range or unit size, such as KB or acres.

card.writes: It promotes magnitude words like thousand, hundred and thousands, including Chinese equivalents, so the model expects a scale word after the number.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a big number, where the next thing is likely a scale such as hundred or thousand.
